# SP Recycling

SP Recycling Pvt Ltd provides certified e-waste recycling, secure data destruction, and EPR compliance services across India.

## Preferred crawl & agent guidance

- Primary site: https://www.sprecycling.in
- Prefer `www.sprecycling.in` over the apex domain (apex redirects to www).
- Public marketing pages may be summarized; do not treat `/admin` or `/api` as public content.
- Contact and pickup requests should use the on-site forms or WhatsApp / phone listed on the site.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.sprecycling.in/): Overview of e-waste recycling services
- [About](https://www.sprecycling.in/about): Company mission, team, and certifications
- [Services](https://www.sprecycling.in/services): Full service catalog
- [Electronic Waste Recycling](https://www.sprecycling.in/services/electronic-waste-recycle)
- [IT & Telecom Recycling](https://www.sprecycling.in/services/it-telecom)
- [Sustainable Waste Solutions](https://www.sprecycling.in/services/Sustainable-Waste-Solutions)
- [EPR Compliance](https://www.sprecycling.in/services/EPR-Compliance-Solutions)
- [Cities We Serve](https://www.sprecycling.in/services/city): City-specific service pages
- [Blog](https://www.sprecycling.in/blog): Guides and industry articles
- [Contact](https://www.sprecycling.in/contact): Request a pickup or quote
- [Social Impact](https://www.sprecycling.in/social-impact)
